headline: Zoning appeals and variance requests for nine properties across South Kingstown.
summary: The board will consider appeals of zoning violation notices, special use permits, and dimensional variances for several properties, including cottages at Cards Pond Road, a proposed hotel on Main Street, and additions to homes on Park Avenue and Quagnut Drive.
items: Continuation of petition ZA-26-1: Henry Cabrera appeal of Notice of Violation at 3812 Commodore Oliver Hazard Perry Highway, Map 78-3, Lot 7, zoned R200
Petition ZBR-26-28: Room 13, LLC special use permit for alcohol service in proposed hotel at 349 Main Street, Map 56-3, Lot 48, zoned CD
Petition ZBR-26-31: Joshua Smith special use permit and dimensional variance for 168 sq. ft. addition to seasonal cottage at 240 Cards Pond Road (cottage 3E C10), Map 92-1, Lot 9-38, zoned R200
Petition ZBR-26-32: Donald & Pamela Pomeroy dimensional variance for additions to dwelling at 135 Park Avenue, Map 92-2, Lot 144, zoned R20
Petition ZBR-26-29: Adam Smith special use permit to replace 476 sq. ft. cottage with 572 sq. ft. cottage at 240 Cards Pond Road (cottage 4EC10), Map 92-1, Lot 9-55, zoned R200
Petition ZBR-26-33: Theodore Farrell dimensional variance for addition to dwelling at 83 Quagnut Drive, Map 63-3, Lot 25, zoned R40
ZA-26-4: Alexander Petrucci appeal of Zoning Enforcement Officer determination at 84 Frank Avenue, Map 22-1, Lot 88, zoned IND-1
ZA-26-5: Rogers Home Inc. appeal of Zoning Enforcement Officer determination at 28 Columbia Street, Map 57-1, Lot 43, zoned CN
ZBR-26-36: Apollo DiBenedetto special use permit for 159 sq. ft. addition to seasonal cottage at 240 Cards Pond Road (cottage 19EC8), Map 92-1, Lot 9-8, zoned R200
Attendance discussion for potential October 28, 2026 meeting
location: Town Council Chambers, South Kingstown Town Hall, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879
plain_text:
Posted on October 6, 2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Zoning Board of Review Meeting  
Meeting Agenda   
Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 7:00 PM   
South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Robert Cagnetta, Chair 
Thomas Daniels, Vice Chair 
Arlene Hicks, Member 
Geoff Elia, Member 
William MacDonald, Member 
Vacancy, Alt. #1 
Vacancy, Alt. #2 
Vacancy, Alt. #3 
  
A. Call to Order 
B. Chairman Introductions and Instructions 
C. Agenda Items *Order can be subject to change* 
 I. Continuation of petition ZA-26-1: Henry Cabrera, 3812 Commodore Oliver Hazard Perry Highway, 
Wakefield, RI 02879, for an Appeal under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking 
to Appeal a Notice of Violation issued by the Zoning Enforcement Officer (ZEO), dated May 22, 2025, 
related to premises at 3812 Commodore Oliver Hazard Perry Highway. The owner of the property is Henry 
Cabrera, for premises located at 3812 Commodore Oliver Hazard Perry Highway, South Kingstown, 
Assessor’s Map 78-3, Lot 7 and is zoned R200. 
3812 Comm. O. H. Hwy. - Application 
 II. Petition ZBR-26-28: Room 13, LLC, P.O. Box 8163, Warwick, RI 02888, requests a Special Use Permit under 
the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking a Special Use Permit to allow alcohol service 
within the proposed hotel. Lot size is .13 acre. A Special Use Permit is required per Zoning Ordinance 
Section 301 (Schedule of Use Regulations Table), Section 504.18 (Standards for Restaurant with Alcohol), 
and Section 907 (Standards of Relief). Owner of the property is 349 Main Street, LLC, for premises located 
at 349 Main Street, South Kingstown, Assessor’s Map 56-3, Lot 48 and is zoned CD (Commercial Downtown). 
349 Main Street - Application 
 III. Petition ZBR-26-31: Joshua Smith, 45 West Greenville Rd, Greenville, RI 02828, requests a Special Use 
Permit and Dimensional Variance under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to 
construct a 168 sq. ft. addition to the existing seasonal cottage. The addition will exceed 50% of the floor 
area that existed in the year 2000, therefore relief of 40 sq. ft.is requested. Lot size is 50.2 acres. A Special 
Use Permit is required per Zoning Ordinance Section 203 (Special Use Permit for Addition, Enlargement, 
Expansion or Intensification) and Section 907 (Standards of Relief). A Dimensional Variance is required 
per Section 608 (Coastal Community Overlay District). Owners of cottage 3E C10 are Joshua & Beth Smith, 
on property owned by RCB Inc, located at 240 Cards Pond Road, South Kingstown, Assessor’s Map 92-1, Lot 
9-38 and is zoned R200. 
R C BCH R3E C10 - Application 
 IV. ZBR-26-32: Donald & Pamela Pomeroy, 135 Park Ave, Wakefield, RI 02879, requests a Dimensional 
Variance under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to construct multiple additions to 
the existing dwelling. The additions will be 28’ from the front property line and 9.3’ from the side property 
line. The required front and side yard setbacks are 29.4’ and 12.6’, respectively. Relief of 1.4’(front) and 
3.3’(side) are requested. Lot size is .39 acre. A Dimensional Variance is required per Zoning Ordinance 
Section 205 (Single Nonconforming Recorded Lots) and Section 907 (Standards of Relief). Owners of the 
property are Donald & Pamela Pomeroy for premises located at 135 Park Avenue, South Kingstown, 
Assessor’s Map 92-2, Lot 144 and is zoned R20 
135 Park Avenue - Application
Posted on October 6, 2026 
 V. Petition ZBR-26-29: Adam Smith, 140B East Killingly Road, Foster, RI 02825, requests a Special Use Permit 
under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to replace the existing 476 sq. ft. cottage 
with a 572 sq. ft. cottage. Lot size is 50.2 acres. A Special Use Permit is required per Zoning Ordinance 
Section 203 (Special Use Permit for Addition, Enlargement, Expansion or Intensification), Section 608 
(Coastal Community Overlay District) and Section 907 (Standards of Relief). Owner of cottage 4EC10 is 
Jacquelyn Smith on property owned by RCB Inc., located at 240 Cards Pond Road, South Kingstown, 
Assessor’s Map 92-1, Lot 9-55 and is zoned R200. 
R C BCH R4E C10 - Application 
 VI. Petition ZBR-26-33: Theodore Farrell, 83 Quagnut Drive, Wakefield, RI 02879, requests a Dimensional 
Variance under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to construct a 6.5' x 30.2' addition 
to the dwelling. The addition will be located 12' from the west side property line. The required side yard 
setback is 16.8', therefore, relief of 4.8' is requested. Lot size is .77 acre. A Dimensional Variance is required 
per Zoning Ordinance Section 205 (Single Nonconforming Recorded Lots) and Section 907 (Standards of 
Relief). Owners are Theodore & Shirley Farrell for premises located at 83 Quagnut Drive, South Kingstown, 
Assessor’s Map 63-3, Lot 25 and is zoned R40. 
83 Quagnut Drive - Application 
 VII. ZA-26-4: Alexander Petrucci, 220 Knowlesway Extension, Narragansett, RI 02882, requests an Appeal under 
the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to Appeal the determination of the Zoning 
Enforcement Officer (ZEO), set forth in a letter dated August 11, 2026. The owner is Sophia Industrial Park, 
LLC for premises located at 84 Frank Avenue, South Kingstown, Assessor's Map 22-1, Lot 88, and is zoned 
IND-1. 
84 Frank Avenue - Application 
 VIII. ZA-26-5: Rogers Home Inc., 70 Foster Sheldon Road, Wakefield, RI 02879, requests an Appeal under the 
Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to Appeal the determination of the Zoning 
Enforcement Officer (ZEO), set forth in a letter dated August 27, 2026. The owner is Rogers Home Inc. for 
premises located at 28 Columbia Street, South Kingstown, Assessor's Map 57-1, Lot 43, and is zoned CN. 
28 Columbia Street - Application 
 IX. ZBR-26-36: Apollo DiBenedetto, 7715 Post Road, Suite 112, North Kingstown, RI 02852, requests a Special 
Use Permit under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to construct a 159 sq. ft. 
addition on the seasonal cottage. Lot size is 50.2 acres. A Special Use Permit is required per Zoning 
Ordinance Section 203 (Special Use Permit for Addition, Enlargement, Expansion or Intensification), 
Section 608 (Coastal Community Overlay District) and Section 907 (Standards of Relief). Owners of cottage 
19EC8 are Darlene Nebinger & Michelle DiBenedetto on property owned by RCB Inc., located at 240 Cards 
Pond Road, South Kingstown, Assessor’s Map 92-1, Lot 9-8 and is zoned R200. 
R C BCH R19E C8 - Application 
D. Other Items 
 I. Attendance for potential October 28, 2026, Zoning Board of Review meeting 
 II. Approval of the August 19, 2026 Zoning Board of Review Minutes 
 III. Discussion 
 IV. Adjournment
